evaluation_metrics.primary_definition: The generated Step9 logical XLanguage model passes the XLanguage compiler/build check in a final one-shot evaluation.
evaluation_metrics.compiler_feedback_policy: Compiler diagnostics are never fed back to the model and never trigger repair.
evaluation_metrics.gate_feedback_policy: For gated groups only, Schema/static/semantic gate diagnostics may be fed back to the same generation mode for bounded rework before final compiler evaluation.

groups.label: JSON IR with matched static gates
groups.notes: Step9-style JSON IR condition using Schema checks, low-risk normalization, a semantic rule gate, and bounded gate-guided rework before final evaluation.

groups.label: JSON IR without explicit gates
groups.notes: Generates SystemModel JSON IR and sends it directly to minimal deterministic code generation. If malformed JSON/structure makes code generation fail, the sample is counted as failed.

groups.label: Direct XLanguage with matched static/semantic gate
groups.notes: Directly generates logical XLanguage, then applies a static XLanguage gate plus matched structural-semantic checks with strength no greater than the original JSON IR gate. Checks cover declared ports/states/symbols, transition targets, connection direction/type, and timeout-driven output source. Failed gate diagnostics can guide bounded direct-XLanguage rework. No XCom compile/run feedback is used for repair.

groups.label: Direct XLanguage without gates
groups.notes: Directly generates logical XLanguage. No intermediate gate is applied before final artifact evaluation.
